name: Higashi no Kuni no Youjokuki
source:
You are a "magician".
You've arrived at the faraway world of Gensoukyou...
A man whose magic is more powerful than all others...
Who will be your next target?

(summary translated from http://v112cr.aslia.net/east_youjoku_story_top.htm)
